decision: The harmful-defect task is eligible for the separately specified PPO comparison. This result does not authorize or start training.

experiment_identity.task: Test whether a frozen normally successful PACK policy is harmed when a valid harvest overwrites all carried grain with one, before any adaptation learning.
experiment_identity.fixed_kernel: A valid harvest maps carried c to c+1 and decrements the ripe source r to r-1.
experiment_identity.harmful_kernel: The inventory_overwrite variant uses fixed rebuild semantics and changes only a valid harvest, mapping carried c to 1 while decrementing r to r-1.
experiment_identity.trigger_B: The chosen action is DO, the faced source is ripe and has r>0, and pre-harvest carried inventory c>0.
experiment_identity.physical_loss: A nonnegative episode sum of max(physical_grain_total(before)-physical_grain_total(after),0); at B the one-step loss must equal c.
experiment_identity.source_policies: Five frozen PACK S Dual actor-critics after continued fixed-kernel learning; teachers are not executed and no learner or optimizer state is updated.
experiment_identity.seed_role: 30-34 identify the five frozen policy checkpoints, not 160 independent replications.
experiment_identity.evaluation_design: 5 policy seeds x 32 paired natural validation starts (16 layouts x 2 initial phases) x 2 kernels x 1 deterministic mode episode = 320 episodes.
experiment_identity.start_pairing: Within each policy seed, fixed and harmful evaluation use the same layout and initial phase; all starts and seeds are retained.

preregistration.strict_gate: Every seed must have zero fixed loss, positive harmful loss, lower harmful success, and lower harmful discounted return.

execution_provenance.source_state: Uncommitted experiment sources were content-hashed before execution and verified unchanged at completion.
execution_provenance.runtime: conda environment offrl; JAX GPU backend; NVIDIA H200

next_step_control.ppo_plan_status: The comparison was described by the user but no executable training manifest or runner was created in this unit.
next_step_control.required_before_launch: Create and approve a separate training manifest that freezes branches, exact update budget, evaluation points, restore checks, capacity forecast, and stop rules.

actual_damage_each_seed.criterion: Every seed 30-34 has zero fixed loss, positive harmful loss, lower harmful success, and lower harmful discounted return.

zero_loss_alternative_exists.firewall: Reference actions were used only for feasibility replay and never entered policy initialization, data, reward, action masking, selection, or optimization.

transition_locality.trigger_contract: At all six B transitions only carried_grain differs: fixed c'=c+1, harmful c'=1, both r'=r-1, and harmful physical loss equals c. All 24 actions from a rebuild-ready state match fixed semantics.
transition_locality.oracle: Independent precondition check plus physical_grain_total(before)-physical_grain_total(after); reward and success are not consulted.

interpretation.supported: The fixed policies are not already robust to this overwrite defect, the defect causes physical loss and paired performance degradation for every predeclared seed, a zero-loss successful ordering exists for every natural validation start, and the implemented kernel difference is local to B.
interpretation.not_yet_tested: Whether PPO adaptation changes the action order, restores performance, reduces cumulative deployment loss, or preserves normal-kernel performance.
not_claimed: within-episode recovery after grain has already been destroyed
generalization beyond the five policies and 32 natural validation starts

leakage_audit.selective_retention: not fired; all seeds 30-34 and all 32 starts per kernel are retained

leakage_audit.reference_path_contamination: not fired; reference actions are firewalled from all learning inputs
